text:
Maria (People Ops): Quick FYI — a hiring manager flagged that candidate forms submitted via the new 'hire packet' flow aren't populating the ATS 'interview role' field, so interviewers get generic templates. Anyone else see?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I can repro on a fresh hire packet. The candidate record gets created but interview.role is null. Scheduler picks default template -> too generic.
Lee (Recruiter): Hit this twice today. Interviewers complain the scorecard doesn't match role expectations.
Priya (Learning): That breaks targeted interviewer training checks too — we show role-specific checklists if interview.role present.
Dev (Eng): Quick glance at integration logs: the hire-packet service writes candidate.custom_fields as strings; we expect interview.role to be enum. Looks like a mapping change in last deploy.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Any chance the frontend renamed the field key? The payload example in logs shows "position_title" instead of "interview_role".
Dev (Eng): Yep, frontend refactor changed to position_title for taxonomy reasons but the backend mapping wasn't updated. My bad.
Maria (People Ops): OK — what's the safe rollback or patch? This affects live panels tonight.
Dev (Eng): Two fixes: 1) quick mapping shim in the API to accept position_title and set interview_role, 2) revert frontend change if needed. I'll ship shim as a hotfix; low-risk.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Can you also add a one-off backfill to update interview.role for candidates created since the deploy? We have a list of 12 affected candidates.
Dev (Eng): Sure. I'll deploy shim and run a backfill SQL update like: UPDATE interviews SET role = COALESCE(role, (SELECT value FROM candidate_custom_fields WHERE key='position_title' LIMIT 1)) WHERE created_at > '2026-03-23'; I'll batch it and monitor.
Priya (Learning): After backfill, please notify me so I can re-run role-specific checklist triggers for affected interviewers.
onboarding-bot: audit.log:deploy  user=Dev  release=hotfix/position-title-mapping
Dev (Eng): Hotfix deployed, shim accepts both keys. Starting backfill for 12 candidates in 50-item batches. Monitoring now.
Lee (Recruiter): Noted two interviewers' templates auto-corrected already. Thanks.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I'll reach out to hiring managers for those 12 and confirm the scorecards look right. Adding onboarding checklist item: validate candidate->interview field mappings after any frontend rename.
Dev (Eng): Backfill finished, no errors. Verified interview.role populated for all 12.
Priya (Learning): Re-fired role-check triggers; interviewers received the correct role checklist.
Maria (People Ops): Action items: Dev hotfix & backfill (done), Sam to add checklist and notify hiring managers, Priya to re-run learning checks (done). Closing this thread unless anyone sees regressions.
Lee (Recruiter): All good on my end. Closing. :white_check_mark:
